release_notes:
1. Added native sGTM GA4 Client compatibility: Encodes webhooks into canonical GA4 beacon format when GA4 Measurement ID is provided, guaranteeing HTTP 200 acceptance.
2. Added sGTM Debug / Preview Header support (X-Gtm-Server-Preview) for real-time live debugging inside GTM Server Preview mode.
3. Automatic self-healing hook registration in Back Office to ensure zero missed webhook events.
